newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - HRW basis expected to rise.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - HRW basis expected to rise.

text.p: Basis bids for hard red winter wheat were steady Tuesday but several High Plains grain dealers said they expected an increase later today after U.S. Gulf bids firmed.
"Gulf basis bid improved yesterday by about three cents so I expect the interior basis to come up by the end of the day," a Kansas merchandiser said.
He said movement was slow as KCBT wheat futures slipped.
"It's been fairly slow," another Kansas merchant said. "Not many rail cars were offered out yesterday and the few that were went to Kansas City."
A third Kansas dealer said he did not expect much farmer selling on Tuesday despite strength in Gulf bids.
"Farmer selling was pretty slow yesterday and we're not looking for much today," he said. "The Gulf values changed a little bit yesterday but nothing major, not enough to shake much (wheat) loose."
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: U=KCBT September. unq- unquoted, na - not applicable)
